description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_국내우편물 종적 조회 서비스 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 우체국 등기번호(13자리)를 이용하여 건별 국내등기우편물의 배송내역을 조회하는 OPEN API 서비스입니다. ㅇ 출력하는 항목(사용자가 응답 받게 되는 데이터): 발송인, 수취인, 등기번호, 우편물종류, 취급구분, 배달일자, 배달상태, 종적목록(날짜, 시간, 현재위치, 처리현황, 상세설명) 이 문서는... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 경제경영, 마케팅, 물류유통관리, 배송조회, 등기번호. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-07-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
